Powers & Rules

Powerups spawn randomly around the map. Tap one to see what it does and how long it's got left, then hit Collect to grab it.

🫥 Invisibility

Removes you from everyone else's map for a while — you keep playing and pushing blips as normal, other players just can't see your dot.

🧨 Sabotage — taggers only

Drops a temporary red zone near a runner — not right on top of them, but close enough to force a detour. Anyone inside it gets the same warning as stepping outside the main boundary.

🚨 Train Sabotage — taggers only

Marks a whole train line as restricted for a while, chosen near a runner (but never the line they're currently on). Same warning zone as Sabotage, just following the track instead of a circle.

📡 Radar Scanner

Your whole team switches to fast live-tracking of each other for a while, instead of waiting on the shared 5-minute blip.

🔍 Reveal — runners only

Permanently locks onto one random other player and shows you their true role forever, even after this game ends — no timer on this one.

🫂 Clone

Spawns a few decoy dots that stick near you and blip on your same schedule. They show up exactly like you would — no one else can tell which dot is really you.

👻 Ghost Trail

Spawns a single decoy that peels off in a random direction the moment you use it, and just keeps walking that way on its own — a false trail leading away from you.

🧭 Hunt — taggers only

Locks onto the nearest runner and highlights their live location on your map for a while, refreshed faster than the normal blip.

🧪 Unstable Antidote

A gamble, for either side: 66% chance it converts a random player from the other side to yours. 33% chance it backfires and converts one of your own instead.
